name: Zuihou de 47 Xiaoshi
source:
"Let's break up in 47 hours!"

The girl who has been in love with me for six years and will become my sweet bride next month, now declares.

That feels strange though, she looks serious. Anyway, it seems that I have to play along with her to run this game, recall all the memories of our past, and finally, meet the end of the declared last forty-seven hours together.

Are we really going to say goodbye after forty-seven hours?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010870/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
“47小时后我们分手吧！”

那个爱了我六年、下个月将成为我甜蜜新娘的女孩现在宣布了。

虽然感觉很奇怪，但她看起来很严肃。不管怎样，看来我必须和她一起玩这个游戏，回忆起我们过去的所有记忆，最终迎接共同宣告的最后四十七小时的结局。

四十七小时后我们真的要说再见吗？

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1010870/]Steam[/url]]
